title: metric-summaries-glance-mode-interaction-sweep-and-stakeholder-alignment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and validate a compact 'Glance' mode for the Console dashboard metric summaries. This ticket captures the interaction sweep, visual-polish redlines, and stakeholder alignment ahead of engineering handoff. Goals: 1) surface top-line metrics with density-preserving layout, 2) provide consistent micro-interactions for metric expansion and drill-in, 3) ensure token-cost visibility and rollout-safe states, 4) meet AA accessibility for contrast and keyboard focus. Acceptance criteria: Figma prototype with interactive expand/collapse, documented redlines, accessibility checklist, and signoff from PM and Eng readiness comment.
comments: 2026-02-26 — Aisha: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Agreed scope: two density presets (compact, regular) and a transient detail flyout. Action: deliver prototype for stakeholder demo by 2026-03-05.

2026-03-03 — Marco: First interactive prototype posted. Notes: row truncation strategy uses inline ellipses with tooltip on hover; expansion animation set to 180ms. Need feedback on keyboard affordances for expand/collapse.

2026-03-04 — Design review (Product + Analytics): Recommend replacing tooltip-only cost visibility with a persistent micro-badge for 'estimated token cost' to avoid discoverability issues. PM requests proposed copy variations.

2026-03-06 — Aisha: Revised prototype includes token-cost micro-badge and keyboard support (Enter/Space to expand rows). Updated Figma frames and added focus state redlines. Pushed updated assets to Drive.

2026-03-08 — Accessibility review (Saria, a11y): Contrast adjustments on metric sparklines and reduced motion option added. Need to ensure focus order in expansion flow; flagged as a11y-blocker until fixed.

2026-03-09 — Marco: Implementability review with Eng. Trade-offs noted: continuous batching metrics may require a separate endpoint for the compact view to avoid expensive joins. Eng asks for a simplified data payload: id, metric, delta, mini-sparkline-encoded, token_estimate.

2026-03-10 — Stakeholder demo: Leadership liked the glance density but requested a 'pin' affordance so teams can lock important metrics. Decided to add as a follow-up low-effort enhancement (sub-issue created).
2026-03-11 — QA handoff: Added QA checklist in Drive (keyboard nav, expansion timing, cost-badge correctness, responsiveness 320px-1440px). Assigned QA owner: Priya Sharma.
2026-03-12 — Aisha: Final visual redlines uploaded. Waiting on PM signoff for rollout phasing (canary to 5% then 25% then global). Updated release tag on ticket.
